lemma weighted_unique (G : Gauge) : ∃ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ ∧ ∀ (n : Type) [Fintype n],
    ∀ (w : n → ℝ), (∀ i, 0 ≤ w i) → (∑ i, w i) = 1 → ∀ f : n → G.El,
    (∃ u : G.El, (∑ i, w i * G.price (f i * u⁻¹))<δ) → ∃! u, G.Nearest u (∑ i, w i • G.mat (f i)) := by
  obtain ⟨r,hr,H⟩ := G.nearest_tube
  have hg : 0 < (G.repDim:ℝ)*2 := mul_pos (by exact_mod_cast G.dimPos) two_pos
  refine ⟨r^2/((G.repDim:ℝ)*2),by positivity,fun n _ w hw hb f ⟨u,hu⟩ => H _ u ?_⟩
  apply (sq_lt_sq₀ (norm_nonneg _) hr.le).1
  calc
    _ = ‖∑ i, w i • (G.mat (f i)-G.mat u)‖^2 := by
      simp_rw [smul_sub]; rw [Finset.sum_sub_distrib, ← Finset.sum_smul,hb]; simp only [one_smul]
    _ ≤ _ := weighted (fun i => G.mat (f i)-G.mat u) w hw hb
    _ < _ := by
      simp only [← price_diff, ← mul_assoc (G.repDim:ℝ), mul_comm ((G.repDim:ℝ)*2)]
      simpa only [Finset.sum_mul, mul_assoc (w _)] using (lt_div_iff₀ hg).mp hu

proof_context.conclusion: For weights summing to 1 and a point with weighted price `< r^2/(repDim*2)`, `‖m - mat u‖ < r` so the nearest point is unique (`nearest_tube`), with the cutoff independent of the weights and their number.

lemma min_iff (w : n → ℝ) (hw : ∑ i, w i = 1) (f : n → G.El) (u : G.El) :
    G.Nearest u (∑ i, w i • G.mat (f i)) ↔ ∀ v : G.El,
      (∑ i, w i * G.price (f i * u⁻¹)) ≤ (∑ i, w i * G.price (f i * v⁻¹)) := by

proof_context.conclusion: `G.Nearest u m` iff `u` minimizes the weighted price.

theorem predictor_unique : ∃ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ ∧ ∀ C : KernelChoices, C.predictor_cut ≤ δ → ∀ P : Patch,
    ∀ Y : P.Connector G, P.usesBest C Y → ∃! u, ∀ v, P.bondCost Y u ≤ P.bondCost Y v := by
  obtain ⟨δ,hn,H⟩ := weighted_unique G
  refine ⟨δ,hn,fun C hc P Y h => ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨u,hu,hy⟩ := H P.Points P.weight P.weight_nonneg P.weight_sum Y ⟨P.best Y, lt_of_lt_of_le h hc⟩
  exact ⟨u, (min_iff P.weight P.weight_sum Y u).1 hu, fun j hj => hy j ((min_iff _ P.weight_sum Y _).2 (show ∀ _, _ from hj))⟩

proof_context.conclusion: For `predictor_cut ≤ δ` and `usesBest`, the predictor minimizer is unique.
